facts.fact: Human Rights Watch says critic and journalist Timothy Kalyegira was seized on 26 June 2026 after asking why he was held, asked 'Why do you hate the First Family?', and charged three days later with operating digital news outlets without a licence.
Human Rights Watch says activist Miria Matembe was detained by soldiers on 28 June 2026, two days after a YouTube interview criticising the army chief, and then charged with promoting sectarianism.

Human Rights Watch says the army has besieged the premises of the Nation Media Group since 28 June 2026 after the army chief ordered its television and newspaper operations shut, forcing it to cease operations over negative coverage of the president.
